title: BE READY! Tuesday Could Change Everything for Stocks
creator: Joseph Hogue, CFA
summary: Joseph Hogue's weekly outlook centers on Tuesday's CPI report (headline expected +6% m/m, 3.7% y/y on September's Iran-related oil spike) and the Q3 earnings kickoff from the banks. His calls: HOLD SpaceX (SPCX) — +54% from July lows (+$750B market cap) on Barclays' $254 initiation and a low-band spectrum deal, but ~80x earnings on $2/share next-year profits plus lockup overhang through early December keeps him sidelined another month. BUY Synopsys (SNPS) — $1B+ Amazon IP deal (Trainium/Graviton royalties), an OpenAI partnership building a 'GPT for chip design' with revenue share, and 15%/yr revenue guidance to 2030 well above Street (operating margins 44%->50%); a deeper video is promised for Wednesday. BUY Astera Labs (ALAB) as the key AI data-center networking bottleneck alongside Marvell (MRVL), now an explicit BUY (flip from UNCERTAIN) as an accelerator-chip player inside Nvidia's ecosystem. Memory names: BUY Micron (MU) — 0.09x PEG, ~104% revenue and 151% EBITDA growth (flip from UNCERTAIN) — and BUY SanDisk (SNDK) — 0.9x PEG, revenue expected to double; STX and WDC discussed but not preferred. AI power: BUY Bloom Energy (BE) reiterated at 0.4x PEG despite +223% 1-yr, and BUY Vistra (VST) over Constellation (CEG) on 0.5x vs 1.5x PEG. Banks: BUY Bank of America (flip from AVOID) — 1.4x book, 8.5% expected revenue growth — AVOID JPMorgan reiterated at 2.5x book. Sector view: tech and materials liked, healthcare a defensive bet, energy 'tapped out', hold off on real estate. Caption note: 'IBIDAG'/'EBID' = EBITDA; 'Marll'/'Marvel' = Marvell; 'Vstra'/'Vista' = Vistra; 'Palunteer' not present here.
